title: Candidate-Scoped Bottom Liquid Sensible-Energy Evaluator

dependency_reconciliation.reuse_semantics: exact source blob reused and requalified against the EB-I15 base
dependency_reconciliation.eb_i13_carrier: consumed only through the public candidate/sample contract
dependency_reconciliation.eb_i14_quadrature: terminal local donor temperature per accepted model advance

qualified_behavior: sample-wise outward-positive J/m2 evaluation for thermally complete local outflow
terminal local donor temperature from each accepted sample
exact-zero transfer contributes exactly zero without donor temperature
nonzero inward transfer without explicit external donor temperature makes the total unavailable/incomplete
diagnostic local-outflow subtotal may remain available while the complete total is unavailable
invalid candidate or invalid thermodynamic properties fail closed
no dependency on kernel transaction internals, Richards internals, HeadCalc or MODFLOW
no water rebooking or hydrologic acceptance change
qualification_condition: The EB-I15 bottom sensible energy evaluator workflow must succeed on the exact branch HEAD containing EB-I15_STATUS.json and EB-I15_CLOSURE.md. Older green runs are supporting evidence only.
hard_nonclaims: external groundwater or deep-vadose donor-temperature binding
advective-energy feedback into the governing soil-temperature solve
closed soil or land-column energy balance
next_boundary: Bind external inward donor temperature generically at runtime/coupler level, without teaching the SWAP kernel about MODFLOW, deep-vadose routing or tile composition; accepted energy publication remains a separate transactional integration boundary unless independently qualified.
